svg.text: Denodo 9.0 on Enterprise Base OS Images — VM Scale Set Pipeline (Horizontal Layered View)
Layer 1: Base OS Image, Silent Installer & Secret Manager | Layer 2: Regional VM Scale Set & Internal NLB | Layer 3: Unattended Bootstrap
LAYER 1 — ENTERPRISE BASE OS IMAGE, SILENT INSTALLER STAGING & SECRET MANAGER
Injects denodo.lic & VDP admin password at boot
Attached to MIG VMs for GCS, Secret Manager & BQ Cache
LAYER 2 — DENODO 9.0 BASE-IMAGE VM SCALE SET (REGIONAL MIG), AUTOSCALER & INTERNAL NLB
RHEL 9 Base OS image + n4-standard-8 + 200 GB CMEK disk
Multi-zone HA, 70% CPU autoscaler & TCP :9999 auto-healing
Exposes VDP JDBC (:9999), Design Studio (:9090) & Scheduler
LAYER 3 — UNATTENDED BASE-OS SILENT INSTALLATION & VQL BOOTSTRAP (scripts/install_denodo_vmss_startup.sh)
Installs OpenJDK 17 & pulls Denodo tar.gz + JDBC from GCS
